Name: (CP)Deer Spirit Nook
Author: EndyLau
Description:
本模组源自[b][size=3]停云馆文创工作室[/size][/b]的「鹿灵花坞」造景贴纸系列，现在以家具形式在星露谷中重现！
[b]特别致谢[/b]：感谢 [b]mushymato[/b] 老师为本模组编写代码。

[b]This mod brings the "Deer Spirit Nook" scenery sticker collection from Tingyunge Creative Culture Studio into Stardew Valley as a brand new furniture set![/b]
[b]Special Thanks:[/b] A big shoutout to [b]mushymato[/b] for making this possible with their amazing coding work!

[b]使用须知[/b]：
[list]
[*]本模组为 [b]CP（Content Patcher）[/b]模式，使用前请确保已安装必要的前置文件。[/*]
[*]所有家具均整合进专用的[b]家具目录[/b]，你只需前往[b]罗宾的商店[/b]即可购得，轻松布置属于你的花坞秘境。[/*]
[/list][b]Before You Start:[/b]
[list]
[*]This mod uses [b][color=#ff7700]CP[/color][/b], so make sure you've got the necessary mods installed first.[/*]
[*]All the new furniture is conveniently packed into a custom catalog that you can buy from [b][color=#ff7700]Robin's shop[/color][/b]. Grab it and start building your dream floral retreat![/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: This mod brings the "Deer Spirit Nook" furniture set — originally a scenery sticker collection from Tingyunguan Creative Culture Studio — into the game. With its "deer and flower grove" theme, it adds a fresh, lively touch of nature to your farmhouse.
